items.title: UPM-Kymmene Oyj: UPM and Sappi submit remedies in European Commission review of proposed graphic paper Joint Venture
items.summary: (UPM, Helsinki, November 5, 2026 at 11:00 EET) - UPM and Sappi have formally submitted remedy proposals to the European Commission as part of its ongoing review of the planned graphic paper Joint Venture. The proposed remedies have been offered to support the ongoing review process and do not change UPM's view that the transaction does not raise competition concerns. The remedies consist of…
items.highlights: They include capacity optimization for the supply of certain paper grades in Europe, and related disclosures, with a view to maintaining a competitive and stable market despite the ongoing decline in demand, while taking into account environmental performance. They also include certain commercial safeguards for customers, and investments in decarbonization, electrification and energy efficiency. The Joint Venture is a rational response to the structural decline of graphic paper markets in Europe and would enable a more orderly adjustment of industry capacity while maintaining reliable customer supply and generating significant efficiencies.
